implementation_summary: Added production runtime contract methods to LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 and an opt-in backend smoke test. Native default and fallback behavior preserved.

langgraph_parity_runtime.py: Added create_run(goal, mode='read_only', user_id='local') -> Dict[str, Any]
Added pause_run, resume_run, cancel_run lifecycle methods
Persist run.json and trace events in Native-compatible layout
Set backend_selected='langgraph_parity' and fallback metadata on created run dicts
key_changes.runtime.py: No changes. Fallback guard preserved as-is.

design_decisions: LangGraph opt-in only via AGENT_V2_BACKEND env var
No changes to api_adapter.py; runtime wrapper satisfies production contract
No changes to response_normalizer.py; wrapper produces Native-style run dict
Graph final state translated before returning to api_adapter
Run directory layout matches Native so trace proxy works
Read-only governance enforced inside existing graph nodes
rollback_plan: Unset AGENT_V2_BACKEND or set to native_runtime to restore Native default
